ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white and cream pixels occupy approximately 65-70% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted against low-intensity black pigmentation covering approximately 30-35% of the surface area, primarily along the margins and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) pixels form two large contiguous lobes divided by a vertical low-intensity (black) median column. Low-intensity pixels form a thick continuous band along the trailing edge and lateral tips, with isolated low-intensity clusters (spotting) concentrated in the distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle, showing high pixel depth relative to the adjacent lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme irregular serration characterized by high-amplitude peaks and valleys; multiple large-scale concave segments (notches) are present, particularly a deep semi-circular excision on the left lobe's upper trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges tapering into sharp, slightly hooked lateral tips; the trailing edge trajectory is highly non-linear due to significant irregular tissue loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of approximately 15-20 circular low-intensity spots located on the distal-lateral portion of the left lobe; smaller scattered clusters are visible on the distal right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible in the proximal regions of both lobes, oriented primarily in vertical and diagonal directions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular tissue loss/notching on the trailing edges of both lobes, suggesting significant physical trauma or predation; prominent concave notch on the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan chromatic shift (diatom film) overlaying the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.
